_comment: A delete_database Decision, exactly in the shape `database-tools.ts` files
it (`op: "delete-database"`, the doomed database's name and row count, and
the row fingerprint the apply path re-checks). There is only one shape for
these ops: the propose path sets every name the card needs, and
`decision-labels.ts` refreshes them, so nothing is added on read.
The scenario is the reported gap — one of four same-named "Supplement log"
tables in Health, holding 4 rows. Ids and fingerprints are neutral stand-ins;
